languages.value: more than 50 languages, no language setting needed, handles code-switching; includes en, fr, de
languages.note: No user report in French or German found.

runtimes.value: mlx-audio (mlx-community/VibeVoice-ASR-bf16 and 4-bit; faster than real time on a 16 GB M2 per HF discussion #10); official VibeVoice demo script with an MPS path (float32, sdpa); transformers native (vibevoice_asr) via the separate microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR-HF repo. vLLM plugin is CUDA-oriented. Known issue: decoder loops ('Yes. Yes.') on some long recordings, seen with MLX 4-bit and with bf16 transformers (VibeVoice#373 open)
runtimes.note: Official demo and transformers on MPS: code path exists, no Mac user report found. A GGUF/C++ runtime for llama.cpp is an open PR (#30530), not merged.

Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of Ollama, QwenLM, resemble-ai/chatterbox and mlx-audio (now `Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio`). **Reddit could not be read.** Items from before 13.05.2026 that are not launch discussions are marked "older". web.summary: Unique one-pass speaker separation; unfixed loops; multilingual quality doubtful.
web.verdict: Unique speaker separation; generation loops unfixed; no FR/DE evidence

comments.text: Generation loops (the same word repeated) or never stops, still in October ([HF #22, 14.03 and 07.10.2026](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR/discussions/22)).
Hallucinates a lot, very heavy and slow, poor in multilingual use ([steinvakt2, 28.04.2026, older](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47933955)).
MLX 4-bit on a 16 GB M2: faster than real time, almost the same as bf16 ([HF #10, 08.10.2026](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR/discussions/10)).
More reliable than Whisper or Parakeet; built-in speaker separation seen as a big advantage ([mberg, 28.04.2026, older](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47935982)).
